title: DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA — European locale; '.' and ',' swap roles globally for this program
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. EU-LOCALE.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       CONFIGURATION SECTION.
       SPECIAL-NAMES.
           DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
      *> With DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, literal 1.234,56 is valid and
      *> means 1234.56 in Anglo notation. Edit picture
      *> PIC 9.999,99 produces output like '1.234,56'. A direct
      *> Java port that uses Locale.US silently corrupts all
      *> output.
       01  WS-AMOUNT      PIC 9(7)V99.
       01  WS-AMOUNT-OUT  PIC 9.999.999,99.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 1234567,89 TO WS-AMOUNT.
           STOP RUN.
notes: DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA shifts BOTH literal parsing and edit-picture rendering. A Java port using Locale.US works for English-locale data and silently corrupts European-locale input. Surface the locale as a program-wide configuration that the rewrite must replicate.
